evidence: A silicon atomic layer was grown on a carbon-terminated c(2 x 2) sample surface at 1050°C by Si,H, exposure whose partial pressure was 1 x 10^-6 Torr. A carbon atomic layer was grown at 1050°C by C,H, exposure whose partial pressure was 1 x 10^-6 Torr onto a silicon-covered (3 x 2) sample prepared by the Si,H, exposure.
